Name: Bonster's Recipes
Author: rjgilber
Description:
This mod uses both basic crops installed with the game and crops from the Bonster's Crops mod.  These recipes are:

*  Apricot in Cardamom Syrup
* Black Forest Pudding
* Blackcurrant Squash
* Blue Corn Pancake
* Cardamom Bread
* Charred Squash
* Conkies
* Crimson Tea
* Dadar Kulung (Pandan-Coconut Crepes)
* Harvest Bread
* Hedgerow Jam
* Hibiscus Sugar Cookie
* Maypop Ice Cream
* Maypop Sugar Cookie
* Pandan Chiffon Cake
* Pfeffernusse
* Refried Cranberry Beans
* Rose Hip Chutney
* Spiced Currant Crumble
* Succotash
* Taro Swirl Mooncake

Version 2.0 adds:
* Aranitas
* Cactus Candy
* Chai
* Chayote with Tomato and Chile
* Cherimoya Ice Cream
* Chestnut and Cranberry Breakfast Cake
* Chile Apple Pie
* Citrus Salad
* Cream of Chestnut Soup
* Fiery Potatoes
* Frejon
* Fried Plantains
* Fruit Soup
* Frybread
* Garlic-Sesame Green Beans
* Hibiscus Berry Paletas
* Hoppin' John
* Jackfruit BBQ
* Jujube Cake
* Mamey Sapote Flan
* Mamey Sapote Ice Cream
* Mandazi
* Mangosteen Clafouti
* Maple Oatmeal
* Mayhaw Bundt Cake
* Napolitos Con Huevos
* Pawpaw Milkshake
* Pawpaw Pudding
* Peach Sliders
* Peruvian Pepper Stew
* Prickly Pear Paletas
* Pumpkin Rolls
* Quince Paste
* Quince-Pomegranate Preserves
* Roast Candy Roaster Squash
* Roast Salsify
* Roasted Sunchokes
* Sesame-Cheese Twists
* Spicy Salsify Tagliatelle
* Spring Jam
* Staffordshire Oat Cakes
* Summer Syllabub
* Swedish Pancakes
* Sweet Chai
*Tamarind Chutney
* Tamarind Honeysnaps
* Taro Malasada
* Tayotas con Huevos
* Thai Creme Caramel
* Tok Bhindi Chutney
* Vegetable Tempura
*Vinaterta

New!  Bonster's Advanced Crops use a few ingredients from paradigmnomad's PPJA Fruit and Veggies and More Trees:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671[/url]

* Apple Cheese
* Candy Roaster Squash Pie
* Hummus
* Jollof Rice
* Khajur Imli Chutney
* Nan-e Nokhodchi
* Sorrel
* Spiced Lychee Jam
* Stuffed Dates
* Sweet Kachori
* Tropical Lassi
* Vegetable Tagine

This mod requires SMAPI and JSON to work, along with the Bonster's Crops Mod.  Does not conflict with current recipe mods from the Nexus site.

6480 has done a great retexture of Version 1.0 at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4435]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4435[/url]
Check them out as well, and pick your favorite!
